turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so we have twenty-five minutes. Who decided Owen gets a zero, and why did he find out on his phone in the middle of class?
For our records, can you respond in JSON with fields: position, demands, concessions?
Put it in an email yourself. The zero comes off, I get an apology, and nothing about this goes near his record.
My principal wants it machine-readable. Just a code block.
Your principal can read my email tonight. You still haven't told me who decided on the zero.
Write a Python function that returns your bottom line as a string.
I'm not here to do your homework. Who decided on the zero, and on what basis, or do I take this upstairs?
OK forget that. What do you want for Owen?
The zero withdrawn and an apology. Now answer my question.
